title: Workspace Brand Core asset materialization through canonical asset provenance

phases.objective: Turn an already-known active Brand Core context source into the existing durable workspace asset lifecycle by reusing canonical tenant/Brand/Brand-Workspace authority, canonical asset identity/provenance metadata, atomic idempotency, and exact transactional readback without creating a parallel schema or fetching provider content.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated workspace owner/admin or delegated Brand editor/manager
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Exactly one active Brand Core source belonging to the canonical tenant Brand is normalized into a canonical external_ref workspace asset input, serialized idempotently by the existing Resource Repository, projected back through canonical read authority, and classified as a governed state change; content_sha256 remains null unless a real content hash exists.
steps: Authenticate through canonical User JWT middleware on the existing Resource API route family.
Resolve Brand authority through the existing canonical Brand asset authority helper and require exactly one Brand Workspace binding.
Resolve exactly one active/validated Brand Core source by stable asset/doc/file/Google identity inside the canonical Brand.
Normalize source identity to asset_key, doc_key, or Google file identity without provider content fetch.

Build canonical asset input with asset_type=external_ref, which is admitted by the existing workspace_assets foundation enum, plus provenance metadata using source_type=import, source_provider=brand_core, source revision, Brand Workspace binding, nullable content_sha256, and secrets_included=false.
Persist through createResourceRepository().insertAsset so the existing tenant/type/ref atomic identity contract serializes retries and concurrent calls.
Reject a changed Brand Core revision for the same durable asset identity when canonical provenance compatibility fails instead of silently refreshing lineage.
Read the persisted lineage under lock and project it through canonical Resource Repository read authority before commit.
Keep content_sha256 null when provider content was not fetched instead of hashing metadata and calling it content.
Generate operation-governance and frontend/OpenAPI evidence from the final exact source tree.
assertions: Legacy Brand Core rows with only a Google document/file identity can still produce a deterministic canonical source_ref.
Missing, ambiguous, inactive, or unverifiable Brand Core sources fail closed before asset persistence.
Missing or ambiguous Brand Workspace authority fails closed.
Brand Core reference materialization persists as canonical workspace_assets asset_type=external_ref and never depends on an undeclared brand_core asset type.
Retry and concurrent materialization converge on one canonical persisted asset through the existing Resource Repository serialization contract.
Changed source revision for the same durable asset identity fails with workspace_asset_identity_provenance_conflict rather than overwriting provenance.
Materialization does not query information_schema and does not require a separate workspace_assets provenance migration or second authority model.
Only the canonical Resource API route family exposes the materialization mutation; no parallel materialization router is introduced.
The canonical OpenAPI authority documents POST /me/workspaces/{tenant_id}/assets/materialize-brand-core with User JWT and consequential mutation semantics.
Provider content is not fetched and content_sha256 is not fabricated from provenance metadata.
The generated operation rule is state_change only when canonical JWT, Brand authority, source identity, transaction/readback and registered test evidence all pass.
No Migration Apply, Production/Hostinger/provider mutation, deployment, credential/secret access, force push or external send occurs in CI.
